generator.note: The authored writer embeds openNURBS-generated component UUIDs, so regenerated archives are structurally identical but not byte-identical; each receipt records the SHA-256 of the archive actually read.

positive: line, circle, arc, polyline and rational NURBS curve survive export and reimport with the same variants
NURBS poles agree within 1e-12, weights and knots exactly
polyline segments keep their exact point sequence
negative: an unsupported/reversed polycurve metadata case is refused by the native bridge rather than flattened
a degenerate curve is rejected by the core curve admission
